scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically from the harmonic addition kernel and a trigonometric recurrence. The embedded exact-arithmetic tests check finite examples and are not substituted for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree evaluation only on the three-sphere under the common even angle-period hypothesis; no classification of equality cases, noise-robustness, or ranks at all lower degrees. Publication priority is provisional; an earlier equivalent result may exist.
title: Root-of-unity angles force a sharp harmonic sampling transition on the three-sphere
